instruction: A candid action photograph, eye-level medium full shot, of two boxers in an open-air pavilion. On the left, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) crouches in a defensive stance wearing black sweatpants and black boxing gloves. On the right, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) is seen from behind in black shorts, facing his opponent. In the background on the left, a bystander in a patterned shirt walks past. Bright daylight illuminates the pavilion, casting soft shadows.

R2 is the boxer seen from behind facing R1 as his opponent
R3 is a background bystander walking past rather than a boxer in the fight
